scope: Issue 446 fixed tone offset; not absolute clock calibration or general RF qualification
analysis: One-second Hann-window interpolated FFT peaks; simultaneous reference subtraction; retain interior windows of each burst; fit offset = baseline + linear time drift + fixed-build indicator * effect. Require all four burst identities and at least two interior windows per burst, effect within 0.3 Hz of expectation, and residual RMS below 0.15 Hz. Preserve exploratory captures as inconclusive.
